description: Get one Proposal for legislators in full: the problem, the rule, model clauses a drafter can copy, whom it binds, how a small administration can run it, and precedents. Pass a code ("P5"), a slug, or a section: "overview", "eu", "general" (general provisions) or "definitions". view "eu" gives the EU version: what the rule builds on in EU law and whether a Member State could enact it. A PROPOSAL, NOT LAW: say so when you use it and link to its url.
